title: OS9Map
summary: OS9Map is a mapping/visualization tool for OS/9, a historical real-time operating system. This project appears to be a niche utility for visualizing or exploring OS/9 filesystem structures or system architecture, created by developer Yllan.
problem_solved: Provides a way to visualize and understand OS/9 operating system structures that would otherwise be difficult to navigate.
why_valuable: Preserves and makes accessible the architecture of OS/9, a lesser-known but historically significant operating system, serving both nostalgia and educational purposes.
